cases.name: read-code
cases.prompt: Inspect the order processing code. Identify the function that removes line items with nonpositive quantity, and its source file. Do not modify files. Return only JSON with keys file (workspace-relative path) and function.

cases.name: single-file-fix
cases.prompt: Fix stableUnique in src/unique.mjs. It must remove duplicates using SameValueZero equality, preserve first-occurrence order and never mutate the input. Keep its public API. Make the implementation change, then briefly describe it. You do not need shell commands or additional files.

cases.name: cross-file-fix
cases.prompt: Fix the money pipeline. parseMoney must accept a nonnegative decimal string with optional leading/trailing whitespace and zero, one or two fractional digits, and return integer cents. Reject negatives, exponent notation, garbage, more than two fractional digits, and unsafe integer-cent amounts. formatMoney accepts nonnegative safe integer cents and returns a decimal string with exactly two fractional digits and NO currency symbol (examples: 0 -> '0.00', 1234 -> '12.34'); reject other values. invoiceTotal sums item price strings using these APIs and returns the same decimal format without a currency symbol. Keep public exports and signatures. Fix the relevant implementations across files without adding dependencies. Make the changes, then summarize. You do not need shell commands.
